name: edunexa
description: EduNexa — Class 10 Learning Platform (modular monolith monorepo: Next.js + NestJS)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace packages/types && npm run build --workspace packages/validation && npm run build --workspace packages/config && npm run build --workspace packages/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/admin"
